description: List the objectives — what each pillar has to reach, written as outcomes. Narrow to one pillar with `pillarId`. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor` and `appliedFilters`. When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the SAME filters to get the next page.

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page. Only valid with identical filters.

name: anyforge_list_objectives
title: List objectives
